RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: cooked
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Cooked clean in near-boiling water: paint gone, seams given, a quarter of the metal lost to corrosion.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: frozen
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Locked in the nightside cold since it fell: no rust, no rot, nothing taken. What was inside is still inside.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: picked
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Someone got here first. A salvage-mark is scratched on the rib, and almost nothing is left inside.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: crystal-jacketed
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Grown over by the deep's crystal until the hull is a stone. Whatever the jacket closed over, it kept.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: stripped
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Plundered to the skeleton by every army that crossed it. The plating is gone, the wiring is gone; what is left is what nobody could carry.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: irradiated
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Hot. Nobody has come for it because nobody wants to stand next to it; most of the metal is still there.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: sand-scoured
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Blasted by sand for years until the edges are rounded and the thin metal is gone through.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: sand-sealed
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Buried dry and airless under the dunes until a storm uncovered it. Uncorroded: what was inside is intact.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: ice-locked
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Frozen into the ice where it fell. Cold kept the metal; meltwater took a little.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: eroded
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Eaten down to a fragment by the land itself. Little remains, and less of it is worth anything.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: brined
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Washed up by the surges and left to the brine: a white salt crust over everything, the thin metal eaten through.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: flood-buried
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Half buried in dried flood mud, exposed by the last flood and waiting for the next to take it back.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: overgrown
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Grown through with vines and root. The war that left it is long over; the wood is still eating it.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: digested
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Half dissolved by the Rot's gut. The edges have run like wax, and what is left has a greasy sheen.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: storm-torn
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Torn apart by the chasm winds: vanes snapped, housings ripped open, everything loose long since blown away.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: fresh
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: It came down recently. The paint is scorched but whole, and nobody has had time to pick it over.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.label: sun-baked
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckWeatheringD.description: Left on the open sand under a sun that never moves. The paint has gone to chalk and the seals have cracked.
